title: Build Create Staking Tier proposal
notes: StakingProposal.createStaking(rewardToken, rewardAmount, startedAt, deadline, metadata). stakingProposal addr is read by the tool internally. startedAt is {{now+600}} and NOT a past time: StakingProposal.sol sets _updatedAt = startedAt, so a backdated start accrues over a window with zero shares and strands that slice of the reward. A past DEADLINE does not revert either — the contract bounces the reward and emits StakingRejected, so the tx succeeds with no tier created. That silent outcome is why the tool-side window guard matters (see WP-C / the create_staking_tier guard in src/lib/proposalBuilders.ts).
